```{=html}
<style>
.w121-dd { max-width: 620px; margin: 0 auto; font-size: 0.92rem; }
.w121-dd ol.w121-list { list-style: none; margin: 0 0 0.75rem; padding: 0; counter-reset: w121; }
.w121-dd .w121-item {
  display: flex; align-items: center; gap: 8px; counter-increment: w121;
  border: 1.5px solid var(--bs-border-color, #999); border-radius: 6px;
  background: var(--bs-body-bg, #fff); color: var(--bs-body-color, #222);
  padding: 6px 8px; margin-bottom: 6px; cursor: grab; user-select: none;
}
.w121-dd .w121-item::before {
  content: counter(w121); font-weight: 700; min-width: 1.5em; text-align: center;
  color: #d81e2e;
}
.w121-dd .w121-item.w121-right { border-color: #2e7d32; border-width: 2px; }
.w121-dd .w121-item.w121-wrong { border-color: #d81e2e; border-width: 2px; }
.w121-dd .w121-text { flex: 1; }
.w121-dd .w121-btns { display: flex; flex-direction: column; gap: 2px; }
.w121-dd .w121-btns button, .w121-dd .w121-controls button {
  padding: 1px 8px; border-radius: 6px; border: 1px solid var(--bs-border-color, #999);
  background: var(--bs-body-bg, #fff); color: var(--bs-body-color, #222); cursor: pointer;
  line-height: 1.3;
}
.w121-dd .w121-controls { display: flex; gap: 8px; align-items: center; justify-content: center; flex-wrap: wrap; }
.w121-dd .w121-controls button { padding: 5px 14px; }
.w121-dd .w121-msg { font-weight: 700; min-height: 1.4em; text-align: center; margin-top: 0.5rem; }
.w121-dd .w121-msg.ok { color: #2e7d32; }
.w121-dd .w121-msg.bad { color: #d81e2e; }
.w121-dd .w121-note { font-size: 0.78rem; font-style: italic; opacity: 0.7; }
.w121-dd .w121-expl {
  font-size: 0.85rem; opacity: 0.85; border-left: 3px solid #2e7d32;
  padding: 6px 10px; margin-top: 8px;
}
</style>
<div class="w121-dd iw" id="w121-dd">
  <ol class="w121-list" aria-label="steps to put in order"></ol>
  <div class="w121-controls">
    <button type="button" class="w121-check iw-check">Check</button>
    <button type="button" class="w121-reset iw-reset">Reset</button>
    <button type="button" class="w121-solution iw-solution">Show solution</button>
    <span class="w121-note">(no fun if you click it right away)</span>
  </div>
  <div class="w121-msg iw-msg" role="status"></div>
  <div class="w121-expl iw-expl" hidden>
    The lifecycle runs Preparation → Detection &amp; Analysis → Containment,
    Eradication &amp; Recovery → Post-Incident Analysis: the team, baseline,
    monitoring and tested backups exist <em>before</em> anything happens; the alert
    is validated and scoped before the timeline is built from the logs; isolation
    comes before credential rotation and the clean restore; and the lessons feed back
    into preparation, closing the cycle - see
    <a href="#def-irlifecycle">the definition of the incident response lifecycle</a>
    and <a href="#sec-12-ir-lifecycle">the section on the lifecycle</a>.
  </div>
</div>
<script>
(function () {
  const root = document.getElementById('w121-dd');
  const list = root.querySelector('.w121-list');
  const msg = root.querySelector('.w121-msg');
  // pos = correct position (1-based); INITIAL = fixed scrambled starting order.
  const STEPS = [
    { pos: 1, text: 'Build the team, the plans, the network baseline, the monitoring and the tested backups - before anything happens' },
    { pos: 2, text: 'Validate the alert, estimate the scope and assign an incident manager' },
    { pos: 3, text: 'Build a timeline of the attack from the off-host logs' },
    { pos: 4, text: 'Isolate the affected identities and workloads; revoke sessions' },
    { pos: 5, text: 'Rotate credentials, delete old images and definitions, restore hardened versions from clean IaC' },
    { pos: 6, text: 'Ask what should have gone better and feed the lessons back into preparation' }
  ];
  const INITIAL = [4, 2, 6, 1, 5, 3]; // pos values in starting display order
  let dragEl = null;

  function clearMarks() {
    list.querySelectorAll('.w121-item').forEach(li => li.classList.remove('w121-right', 'w121-wrong'));
    msg.textContent = ''; msg.className = 'w121-msg iw-msg';
  }
  function makeItem(step) {
    const li = document.createElement('li');
    li.className = 'w121-item';
    li.dataset.pos = step.pos;
    li.draggable = true;
    const span = document.createElement('span');
    span.className = 'w121-text';
    span.textContent = step.text;
    const btns = document.createElement('span');
    btns.className = 'w121-btns';
    const up = document.createElement('button');
    up.type = 'button'; up.className = 'w121-up'; up.textContent = '▲';
    up.setAttribute('aria-label', 'move up');
    up.addEventListener('click', e => {
      e.stopPropagation();
      if (li.previousElementSibling) { list.insertBefore(li, li.previousElementSibling); clearMarks(); }
    });
    const down = document.createElement('button');
    down.type = 'button'; down.className = 'w121-down'; down.textContent = '▼';
    down.setAttribute('aria-label', 'move down');
    down.addEventListener('click', e => {
      e.stopPropagation();
      if (li.nextElementSibling) { list.insertBefore(li.nextElementSibling, li); clearMarks(); }
    });
    btns.appendChild(up); btns.appendChild(down);
    li.appendChild(span); li.appendChild(btns);
    li.addEventListener('dragstart', e => { dragEl = li; e.dataTransfer.setData('text/plain', step.pos); });
    li.addEventListener('dragend', () => { dragEl = null; });
    return li;
  }
  list.addEventListener('dragover', e => {
    e.preventDefault();
    if (!dragEl) return;
    const li = e.target.closest('.w121-item');
    if (!li || li === dragEl) return;
    const r = li.getBoundingClientRect();
    const before = (e.clientY - r.top) < r.height / 2;
    list.insertBefore(dragEl, before ? li : li.nextSibling);
    clearMarks();
  });
  list.addEventListener('drop', e => e.preventDefault());
  function build() {
    list.textContent = '';
    INITIAL.forEach(p => list.appendChild(makeItem(STEPS.find(s => s.pos === p))));
  }
  root.querySelector('.w121-check').addEventListener('click', () => {
    let wrong = 0;
    [...list.querySelectorAll('.w121-item')].forEach((li, i) => {
      li.classList.remove('w121-right', 'w121-wrong');
      if (Number(li.dataset.pos) === i + 1) { li.classList.add('w121-right'); }
      else { li.classList.add('w121-wrong'); wrong++; }
    });
    if (wrong === 0) { msg.textContent = '✓ All correct - the lifecycle runs from preparation to lessons learned, and back.'; msg.className = 'w121-msg iw-msg ok'; }
    else { msg.textContent = '✗ Not yet - ' + wrong + ' step(s) out of place. Think of the four phases and their order.'; msg.className = 'w121-msg iw-msg bad'; }
  });
  root.querySelector('.w121-solution').addEventListener('click', () => {
    [...list.children].sort((a, b) => Number(a.dataset.pos) - Number(b.dataset.pos))
      .forEach(li => list.appendChild(li));
    clearMarks();
    [...list.children].forEach(li => li.classList.add('w121-right'));
    root.querySelector('.w121-expl').hidden = false;
    msg.textContent = 'Solution shown - reset to try it yourself.';
    msg.className = 'w121-msg iw-msg ok';
  });
  root.querySelector('.w121-reset').addEventListener('click', () => {
    build(); clearMarks();
    root.querySelector('.w121-expl').hidden = true;
  });
  build();
})();
</script>
```
